wav2vec2_advantages: Faster inference on CPU (no mel-spectrogram computation)
Smaller model footprint (90M params vs Whisper base 74M — similar size but wav2vec2 is more specialized)
Fully open-source Apache-2.0 without additional licensing
wav2vec2_disadvantages: ALL-CAPS output with no punctuation — needs CTC post-processing
Struggles with technical acronyms (RLHF, GPT-4, ChromaDB)
